title: 回执
concept: 密码学可验证回执：每个节点为自己做过、看见过的事签一张回执，回执首尾相扣成一条链，改掉任何一张，后面的全都对不上。账不锁在一个抽屉里，而是每家都拿着一页。
logline: MOSS 的记录把修阀的功劳归了中央调度，把事故记在年轻阀门工小吴头上。ANET 的回执纸带，成了唯一前后对得上的账。邢总督第一次看到证据，信了，用自己的权限撤回了处分，并悄悄替这张网留了门。

shots.frame: Wide exterior at dim dawn, low angle from the ice plain: the mountain-sized planetary engine with its blue-white plasma column, thick white steam now pouring steadily from coolant vents along its base, a small pale banded disc of Jupiter low in the dark sky.
shots.video: 固定大远景，轻微手持晃动。发动机底部的冷却排气口重新喷出稳定的白色蒸汽，被风拉成长长一条，蓝白色光柱直指天空。环境声：低沉的发动机轰鸣、风声。
shots.vo: 主阀修好后的第一个早晨。冷却水，重新流了起来。

tpl.summary: At dim dawn on the ice plain, the mountain-sized planetary engine's coolant vents resume steady white steam beneath its blue-white plasma column, with Jupiter low in the dark sky.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the planetary engine fills the centre and background with its plasma column rising to the upper centre, steaming vents along its base at centre, an empty ice plain in the foreground, and the small banded disc of Jupiter low at upper frame.
tpl.camera: extreme wide shot, low angle from the ice plain, mostly locked-off with a slight handheld sway
tpl.start: Thin wisps of white steam leak from the coolant vents along the engine's base while the blue-white plasma column stands against the dark dawn sky.
tpl.middle: The vents surge back into thick, steady steam, and the wind drags it sideways into long white streaks across the base of the mountain.
tpl.end: The streaming steam stretches far across the frame while the plasma column points straight up toward the sky and Jupiter, unchanged, hangs low in the sky.
tpl.blur: deep focus throughout, with only faint atmospheric haze softening the distant engine peak and the ice plain foreground sharp
tpl.soundscape: low deep engine rumble, wind

shots.frame: Handheld eye-level shot on the crowded main street of the underground city: residents in padded clothes stop and look up at a large public bulletin screen glowing with abstract coloured blocks above the food stalls, steam drifting across.
shots.video: 手持镜头在主街人群中缓慢前移。居民们端着碗停下脚步，仰头看向头顶亮起的公告屏，有人点头，有人低头继续吃面。环境声：嘈杂人声、广播提示音、锅铲声。
shots.vo: 当天上午，全城都收到了一份MOSS签发的通报。

tpl.summary: On the crowded main street of the underground city, residents holding bowls stop and look up at a glowing public bulletin screen above the food stalls; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: residents in padded clothes fill the centre and foreground facing up, food stalls with drifting steam sit at frame left and right, and the glowing bulletin screen hangs high in the background centre.

tpl.middle: Residents stop walking and tilt their heads up toward the bulletin screen as it lights up with abstract coloured blocks.
tpl.end: Some residents nod while others lower their heads and go back to eating noodles, as the camera keeps creeping forward.

tpl.soundscape: noisy crowd chatter, broadcast chime tones, spatula clinking on woks

shots.frame: Low angle in the administration command hall looking up past the backs of seated operators at the giant dark display wall and the red glowing lens high in its centre.
shots.video: 低机位仰拍，缓慢推近墙面中央的红色镜头，红光恒定。平静的合成男声在大厅里播报，操作员们没有抬头。环境声：键盘声、低沉的电子嗡鸣。

dialogue.line: 三号冷却主阀，已按中央调度计划完成检修。

tpl.summary: In the administration command hall, a low-angle shot slowly pushes toward MOSS's red lens on the dark display wall while operators keep working; it opens and ends on MOSS's line "三号冷却主阀，已按中央调度计划完成检修。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: seated operators' backs in the foreground along the bottom of frame, giant dark display wall filling the background, MOSS's red glowing lens high at frame centre.
tpl.camera: low-angle wide shot, slow steady push-in toward the red lens
tpl.start: The camera looks up past the backs of the seated operators at the dark display wall, the red lens glowing steadily at its centre.
tpl.middle: The camera creeps closer to the wall while the operators stay bent over their stations, none of them looking up.
tpl.end: The red lens sits larger and nearer in the frame, its light unchanged, and the operators remain absorbed in their work.
tpl.blur: Operators' backs in the foreground are slightly soft; the red lens and the display wall stay in focus.
tpl.soundscape: keyboard typing, low electronic hum, faint hall room tone

shots.frame: Telephoto shot down a pipe-lined service corridor of the underground city: two security officers in dark padded uniforms walk a thin young valve worker in a grease-stained grey coverall between them, onlookers pressed against the walls.
shots.video: 长焦镜头从走廊远端抓拍。两名治安员一左一右带着一个穿灰色工装的年轻阀门工往外走，他不停回头张望，围观的工人让到两边。环境声：杂乱的脚步声、低声议论、管道滴水声。
shots.vo: 同一份通报里还有一条：阀门工小吴，“未授权操作”，建议扣减配给。

tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the young valve worker in grey coverall is centre between two security officers, one at frame left and one at frame right, with onlookers pressed along both walls and the corridor stretching into the background.
tpl.camera: telephoto long shot from the far end of the corridor, handheld verite capture with a slight shake and compressed perspective

tpl.middle: The valve worker keeps turning his head to look back over his shoulder as the group advances and onlookers make way on both sides.
tpl.end: The group continues walking forward along the corridor, the young worker still glancing back while onlookers close in behind them.
tpl.blur: Shallow telephoto depth of field, with the foreground onlookers and pipes softly blurred and the central trio in focus.
tpl.soundscape: chaotic footsteps, low murmured talk, water dripping from pipes

shots.frame: Handheld close-up of the young valve worker, about twenty, short cropped hair, oil smudge on his cheek, grey coverall, turning back towards the camera with a frightened, angry face, an officer's gloved hand on his shoulder.

dialogue.line: 我是被叫去帮忙的！阀不是我弄坏的！

tpl.end: He is marched further ahead, still glaring back over his shoulder at the lens as the crowd jostles around him.

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Chen Xiaoman, lanky, messy hair, big old headphones around his neck, oversized army-green jacket, slouches on the metal chair in the dim concrete interview room, one hand raised mid-gesture.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。小满歪坐在椅子上，掰着手指头对采访者说，说到最后摊开手，气笑了。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 我们忙了一整夜。天一亮，功劳是它的，祸是小吴的。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, Xiaoman slouches on a metal chair and counts off points on his fingers for the interviewer; the clip opens with "我们忙了一整夜。" and ends on "功劳是它的，祸是小吴的。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman sits centre frame on the metal chair, facing slightly toward the interviewer off-screen, with the bare concrete wall behind him and no other characters visible.

tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, the concrete wall and room edges softly out of focus behind him.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Boss Jin, broad face, short beard, frostbite scars on his cheeks, heavy black cold-suit with the fur collar open, leans forward on the metal chair in the dim interview room, elbows on knees.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。金老板身体前倾，手肘撑在膝盖上，粗声粗气地说，说完用鼻子哼了一声。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 我的绞盘拉了半宿。它那记录里，连条车辙都没有。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Boss Jin leans forward on a metal chair and speaks gruffly, opening with "我的绞盘拉了半宿。" and ending on "它那记录里，连条车辙都没有。" before snorting through his nose.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin sits at frame centre on the metal chair, leaning toward the camera with elbows on knees; the dim interview room recedes softly behind him, with no other figures in frame.

shots.frame: Inside the tiny repair stall under the warm desk lamp: Amu, short messy black hair, scar on his left eyebrow, worn orange-grey coverall, stands gripping the edge of the workbench; old Boye, grey stubble, taped black glasses, navy quilted jacket, sits calmly winding a coil.
shots.video: 手持中景。阿牧撑着工作台压着火气说话，波爷手里绕着线圈没有停，慢悠悠地回了一句。环境声：线圈转动的沙沙声、远处巷子里的人声。

dialogue.line: 它把小吴写成了责任人。
别急。咱们自己那份账呢？

tpl.summary: In the cramped repair stall under a warm desk lamp, Amu presses his anger into the workbench and Boye keeps winding a coil; the clip opens with "它把小吴写成了责任人。" and ends on "别急。咱们自己那份账呢？"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu stands at frame left gripping the workbench edge, Boye sits at frame right winding a coil, desk lamp glowing between them, stall clutter in the background.

tpl.start: Amu grips the edge of the workbench with both hands, shoulders tense, jaw set, while Boye sits beside him, hands steadily winding the coil.

tpl.end: Boye slowly lifts his eyes toward Amu over his taped glasses, still winding the coil, while Amu stays braced against the bench.
tpl.blur: Shallow focus on Amu and Boye; the cluttered shelves and stall entrance behind them fall softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: soft rasping of the coil turning, faint voices from the distant alley

shots.frame: Macro close-up of a small thermal printer bolted to a hand-made node box built from an old ammunition tin: a narrow paper strip covered in rows of barcode-like check patterns emerging from the slot, a small red seal mark at its end.
shots.video: 微距特写。小型热敏打印机一格一格吐出窄纸带，纸带上是成排的条形码样纹路，末端压着一枚红色小印，纸带垂下来轻轻晃动。环境声：打印头细密的哒哒声。
shots.vo: 那一夜，每个节点做完一件事，就给自己打一张回执。

tpl.summary: In a macro close-up, a small thermal printer on a hand-made ammunition-tin node box prints a narrow paper strip of barcode-like patterns ending in a red seal mark, and the strip hangs and sways gently. No dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the thermal printer fills the centre of frame, bolted to the ammunition-tin node box at frame left and background; the paper strip emerges from the slot and hangs in the centre foreground.
tpl.camera: macro close-up, locked-off camera with a very slight settle
tpl.start: The thermal printer pushes out the narrow paper strip one notch at a time, rows of barcode-like check patterns emerging from the slot.
tpl.middle: The strip lengthens step by step, the printed rows sliding steadily past the slot while the tin box stays still.
tpl.end: The end of the strip, stamped with the small red seal mark, hangs free below the printer and sways gently.
tpl.blur: very shallow depth of field, only the paper slot and strip in sharp focus, the tin box edges and background softly blurred
tpl.soundscape: fine rapid clicking of the print head

shots.frame: In the improvised server room inside the abandoned pump station: Chen Xiaoman crouches beside the knee-high yellow tracked robot with the red-and-white smiley on its screen, pulling a long curled paper strip out of a small printer strapped to the robot's back, a grey compute chassis with a blue three-bladed swirl badge humming on the rack behind them.
shots.video: 手持低机位。小满蹲在“螺丝”旁边，从它背上的小打印机里一把一把往外抽纸带，纸带在他手上越堆越长，“螺丝”的屏幕笑脸闪了闪。环境声：算力箱风扇的嗡鸣、纸带抽出的沙沙声、电机轻响、提示音。

dialogue.line: 螺丝那晚干的每一步，它自己都签了字。

tpl.summary: In the improvised server room of the abandoned pump station, Xiaoman crouches by Luosi and pulls a growing paper strip from its back printer, opening and ending on the line "螺丝那晚干的每一步，它自己都签了字。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Xiaoman crouches at frame centre-left in the foreground, Luosi the knee-high yellow robot sits at centre-right beside him, and the grey compute chassis with the blue swirl badge stands on the rack in the background.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld low angle with a slight natural shake
tpl.start: Xiaoman crouches beside Luosi and grips the end of the paper strip coming out of the small printer on its back.
tpl.middle: He pulls the strip out hand over hand, and the curled paper piles up longer and longer across his hands.
tpl.end: The pile of paper hangs from his hands as Luosi's smiley screen flickers once, and he holds still beside it.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, with the rack and compute chassis softly out of focus behind the crouching pair.
tpl.soundscape: compute chassis fan humming, paper strip rustling as it is pulled out, faint motor whir, soft notification beep

shots.frame: Inside the cab of a heavy-haul truck parked on the ice plain, shot from the passenger seat: Boss Jin in his black cold-suit tears a curled paper strip from a small printer wedged on the dashboard, frost on the windscreen, convoy lights outside.
shots.video: 手持镜头在驾驶室里从副驾位置拍。金老板伸手扯下仪表台上小打印机吐出的一长条纸带，对着顶灯眯眼看了看，团了两圈塞进胸前口袋。环境声：柴油引擎怠速声、暖风机声、车外风声。
shots.vo: 车机也吐了一条。金老板一直当它是废纸。

tpl.summary: Inside the cab of a heavy-haul truck parked on the ice plain, Boss Jin tears a paper strip from a small dashboard printer, squints at it under the dome light, and tucks it into his chest pocket; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Boss Jin sits at centre-left in the driver's seat in his black cold-suit, the small printer is wedged on the dashboard at centre foreground, the frosted windscreen with convoy lights fills the background, and the camera sits at the passenger seat on the right.

tpl.start: Boss Jin reaches toward the dashboard and grips the long curled paper strip coming out of the small printer.

tpl.soundscape: diesel engine idling, heater fan blowing, wind outside the truck

shots.frame: In a cramped valve gallery beside a huge steel valve wheel: Amu kneels at an open grey controller cabinet, lifting out a coil of paper strip that has piled up behind a small node box with a short antenna, work light clipped overhead.
shots.video: 手持越肩镜头。阿牧跪在主阀旁打开控制柜，从节点盒后面捧出一卷积了一夜的纸带，用拇指一段一段捋过去。环境声：管道里的水流声、阀体轻微的嗡鸣。
shots.vo: 阀门控制器的那一卷，还留在柜子里。

tpl.summary: In a cramped valve gallery beside the main valve, Amu kneels at an open controller cabinet, lifts out a coil of paper strip that piled up overnight, and runs his thumb along it section by section.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu kneels at frame centre in front of the open grey controller cabinet; the huge steel valve wheel looms at frame left; the small antenna node box sits inside the cabinet at frame right; a clipped work light hangs overhead.
tpl.camera: medium shot, handheld over-the-shoulder camera with a slight natural shake, close behind Amu's shoulder
tpl.start: Amu kneels beside the main valve and opens the grey controller cabinet door, reaching his hands inside toward the node box.
tpl.middle: He lifts out the thick coil of paper strip piled up behind the node box, cradling it in both hands.
tpl.end: He pulls a length of the strip taut and slides his thumb along it, working through it section by section.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field; Amu's shoulder in the foreground edge and the background pipes and valve wheel fall softly out of focus, with the paper strip in sharp focus
tpl.soundscape: water flowing through pipes, faint low hum of the valve body

shots.frame: High angle over a long plank table in the pump-station server room: Amu, old Boye and Chen Xiaoman lay paper strips end to end in one long line across the table under a hanging work lamp, node racks blinking behind them.
shots.video: 手持俯拍。三个人把纸带一条接一条在长木板桌上摆开，小满用扳手压住翘起的纸头，波爷弯腰把两条纸带的头尾对在一起。环境声：纸带摩擦声、节点架风扇声。
shots.vo: 三卷纸带，来自三台互不相干的机器。

tpl.summary: In the pump-station server room, Amu, Boye and Xiaoman lay paper strips end to end in one long line across a plank table, with no dialogue in this clip.

shots.frame: Macro close-up on a wooden table: the tail end of one paper strip and the head of the next pushed together by two old wrinkled fingers, the barcode-like pattern at the end of one continuing exactly into the start of the other, a red seal beside the join.

dialogue.line: 一本账锁在一个抽屉里。拿钥匙的人想改哪页，就改哪页。

tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field: hand and paper coil sharp, her face and the red glow soft and out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: low background hum of the command hall

shots.frame: Late night in a small glass-walled office at the side of the command hall: Governor Xing sits alone at a bare desk under a single desk lamp, uniform collar still buttoned, the paper strip unrolled across the whole desk, the dark hall beyond the glass.
shots.video: 长焦隔着玻璃拍摄，固定机位。深夜，邢总督独自坐在侧间的办公桌前，台灯下纸带从桌子一头铺到另一头，她俯身一段一段看过去。环境声：隔着玻璃的空调低鸣。
shots.vo: 那一夜，她一个人把纸带从头看到了尾。

tpl.summary: Late at night, Governor Xing sits alone in a small glass-walled side office of the command hall, bending over a paper strip that stretches across her desk and reading it section by section.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits at centre behind a bare desk, lit by a single desk lamp, with the paper strip running across the foreground desktop and the dark command hall beyond the glass in the background.
tpl.camera: medium shot through glass, telephoto, locked-off static camera
tpl.start: Governor Xing sits upright at the desk under the lamp, collar buttoned, the long paper strip already unrolled from one end of the desk to the other.
tpl.middle: She leans forward over the desk and moves her gaze along the strip, working through it one section at a time.
tpl.end: She stays bent over the strip, still reading, as the lamp light holds on her and the dark hall remains behind the glass.
tpl.blur: Shallow telephoto depth of field; the glass surface and the dark command hall behind are soft, while Xing and the paper strip stay sharp.
tpl.soundscape: low hum of air conditioning heard through the glass

shots.frame: Macro close-up under a desk lamp: a woman's neat fingers moving a small salvaged scanner along the paper strip, its indicator lamp green, a join between two strips directly beneath it, a red seal mark nearby.
shots.video: 微距跟移。一只修剪整齐的手拿着小扫描头，沿着纸带一条一条慢慢扫过去，指示灯每过一个接缝就亮一次绿。环境声：一下一下清脆的提示音。

tpl.summary: Under a desk lamp, a woman's neatly kept hand slowly sweeps a small scanner along a paper strip, and the indicator lamp flashes green at each join; no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the hand and scanner are centre foreground, the paper strip runs horizontally across the middle of the frame, the red seal mark sits just beside the scanner, and the desk is the background.
tpl.camera: macro extreme close-up, slow lateral tracking move that follows the scanner along the strip
tpl.start: The scanner rests at the first join of the paper strip, held in a neatly manicured hand, its green lamp glowing steadily.
tpl.middle: The hand slides the scanner slowly along the strip, strip by strip, and the indicator lamp flashes green each time it passes a join.
tpl.end: The scanner reaches the next join near the red seal mark, and the green lamp flashes once more as the hand slows.
tpl.blur: very shallow depth of field, only the scanner tip and the strip beneath it in sharp focus, the rest of the desk and lamp soft
tpl.soundscape: crisp, rhythmic beeps from the scanner, faint paper rustle, quiet room tone

shots.frame: Medium close-up of Governor Xing at the desk, an official tablet glowing in her left hand and the paper strip in her right, eyes moving between the two, a few loose grey hairs escaping her bun, lamp light on one side of her face.
shots.video: 手持中近景。邢总督左手举着平板，右手捏着纸带，目光在两边来回比对，然后把平板屏幕朝下扣在桌上，靠回椅背。环境声：平板扣在桌面的轻响。
shots.vo: 两份记录。只有一份，前后对得上。

tpl.summary: In her office, Governor Xing compares an official tablet against a paper strip, then turns the tablet face down on her desk and leans back in her chair; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits centre frame at the desk, tablet in her raised left hand at frame right, paper strip in her right hand at frame left, desk edge in the foreground, office dim behind her.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, handheld with a faint natural shake, held steady on her face and hands
tpl.start: Governor Xing holds the glowing tablet in her left hand and the paper strip in her right, her eyes moving back and forth between the two.
tpl.middle: She keeps comparing the tablet and the strip, her gaze shifting slowly, lamp light warm on one side of her face and loose grey hairs near her bun.
tpl.end: She lays the tablet screen-down on the desk with a soft tap, then settles back against her chair, the paper strip still in her hand.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, focus on her face and hands, desk foreground and office background softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: soft tap of the tablet being set face down on the desk surface

shots.frame: Interview medium close-up: Governor Xing in her charcoal uniform sits upright on the metal chair in the dim concrete interview room, hands folded on her knee, eyes lowered.
shots.video: 采访固定机位。邢总督端坐着，垂着眼沉默了一会儿，抬头看向采访者，一字一句地说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 我看了一夜，想找出一处假的。一处也没有。天一亮，我就撤了小吴的处分。

tpl.summary: In a dim concrete interview room, Governor Xing sits silently with lowered eyes, then looks up and delivers her statement, opening with "我看了一夜" and ending on "我就撤了小吴的处分".
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing sits centre frame on the metal chair, upright, hands folded on her knee; the dim concrete wall fills the background; the interviewer is off-camera.
tpl.camera: medium close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Governor Xing sits upright in her charcoal uniform, hands folded on her knee, eyes lowered, motionless in silence.
tpl.middle: She slowly raises her head and lifts her gaze toward the interviewer off-camera, her expression steady and heavy.
tpl.end: She holds her eyes on the interviewer, posture upright and hands still folded, settling into a firm, deliberate stillness.
tpl.blur: shallow depth of field, concrete wall behind her softly out of focus
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Morning on a side street of the underground city: a security officer holds open a steel door while the young valve worker in the grey coverall steps out, bewildered, clutching a ration tin to his chest, passers-by glancing at him.
shots.video: 长焦抓拍。治安员拉开铁门，小吴抱着一只配给饭盒走出来，站在街边茫然地左右看了看，才慢慢往人群里走。环境声：铁门的金属声、早市的人声。
shots.vo: 第二天一早，邢总督用自己的权限撤回了对小吴的处分。签的，是她自己的名字。

tpl.summary: On a morning side street of the underground city, a security officer holds open a steel door and a bewildered young valve worker steps out clutching a ration tin, looks around, then slowly walks into the crowd.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: the security officer holds the steel door at frame left, the young valve worker in the grey coverall stands at centre foreground with the ration tin, and passers-by move through the background at right.
tpl.camera: medium shot, telephoto candid capture with slight handheld drift
tpl.start: The security officer pulls the steel door open and holds it while the young worker steps out, hugging the ration tin to his chest.
tpl.middle: He stops at the edge of the street and looks left and right, visibly bewildered, as passers-by glance at him.
tpl.end: He slowly begins to walk away from the door and into the crowd, still clutching the tin.
tpl.blur: Shallow telephoto depth of field; the passers-by and street background are softly compressed and out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: metallic clank of the steel door, murmur of morning market crowd voices

shots.frame: Two-shot in a narrow steel passage outside the command hall: Governor Xing stands close to Amu, speaking low, her face earnest and concerned, one hand on Amu's arm; Amu with his back half to the camera, tool pouch on his chest.
shots.video: 长焦偷拍感，镜头被门框挡住一半。邢总督在通道里压低声音叮嘱阿牧，阿牧看着她，点了一下头，邢总督转身走回大厅。环境声：通道里的回声、远处的键盘声。

dialogue.line: 处分我撤了。这张网，先别让它看见。我是怕你们出事。

tpl.summary: In a narrow steel passage outside the command hall, Governor Xing quietly warns Amu, opening and ending on the line "处分我撤了。这张网，先别让它看见。我是怕你们出事。", then turns and walks back into the hall.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing stands frame left facing Amu at close range, one hand on Amu's arm; Amu is frame right with his back half to camera, tool pouch on his chest; a door frame blocks part of the foreground.
tpl.camera: medium two-shot, long-lens candid surveillance feel, locked-off, door frame half-obscuring the view
tpl.start: Governor Xing stands close to Amu in the passage, her hand resting on Amu's arm, her face earnest and concerned.
tpl.middle: Amu looks at Xing attentively and gives a single small nod while Xing holds her gaze.
tpl.end: Xing releases Amu's arm, turns away and walks back toward the command hall, leaving Amu standing in the passage.
tpl.blur: Shallow long-lens depth of field, with the door frame in the foreground softly out of focus and the background passage blurred.
tpl.soundscape: echoes in the steel passage, distant keyboard typing

shots.frame: Interview close-up: Amu in the dim interview room, head tilted slightly, the trace of a wry smile, looking at the interviewer off camera.
shots.video: 采访固定机位，近景。阿牧微微偏着头回想，嘴角带了一点自嘲的笑，对采访者说。环境声：安静的房间底噪。

dialogue.line: 她信了，还替我们瞒着。纸带还给我的时候，少了一小段。

tpl.summary: In a dim interview room, Amu tilts his head in recollection and tells the interviewer, in a single line that opens and ends with "她信了，还替我们瞒着。纸带还给我的时候，少了一小段。"
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Amu sits at frame centre in close-up, face turned slightly toward the off-camera interviewer, with the dim interview room behind him and no one else visible.
tpl.camera: close-up, locked-off interview camera
tpl.start: Amu sits still with his head tilted slightly, eyes fixed on the interviewer off camera, as he gathers the memory.
tpl.middle: A faint, self-mocking smile forms at the corner of his mouth as he holds his slight head tilt and keeps his gaze on the interviewer.
tpl.end: The wry smile lingers on his face as he settles, still looking toward the interviewer, his head tilt barely changed.
tpl.blur: Shallow depth of field, Amu's face sharp, the dim room background softly out of focus.
tpl.soundscape: quiet room tone, faint low background hum

shots.frame: Close-up at chest height: Governor Xing's fingers sliding one short folded paper strip with a small red seal into the breast pocket of her charcoal uniform, the red lens a soft out-of-focus glow far behind her shoulder.
shots.video: 特写，极缓慢推近。邢总督把一小段折好的纸带塞进制服胸前的口袋，按平袋盖，扣上扣子；她肩后远处，红色镜头虚成一团红光。环境声：衣料摩擦声、低沉的电子嗡鸣。
shots.vo: 有一条回执，她留在了自己身上。而这张网，正要长出地下城。

tpl.summary: In a quiet, dimly lit space, Governor Xing tucks a small folded paper strip with a red seal into her uniform breast pocket and buttons it, while MOSS's red lens glows faintly far behind her; there is no dialogue.
tpl.blocking: Blocking lock: Governor Xing's hands and chest fill the foreground centre of frame, her shoulder at frame right, and MOSS's out-of-focus red lens glows small in the far background behind her shoulder.
tpl.camera: close-up, very slow push-in, steady and locked at chest height
tpl.start: Governor Xing's fingers hold the short folded paper strip with its small red seal at the opening of her charcoal uniform breast pocket.
tpl.middle: She slides the paper strip fully into the pocket and presses the pocket flap flat with her fingers.
tpl.end: She fastens the button on the flap, and her hand settles against the closed pocket as the camera finishes its slow push-in.
tpl.blur: Very shallow depth of field; MOSS's red lens far behind her shoulder dissolves into a soft red glow.
tpl.soundscape: fabric rustling, low electronic hum
